career_ladder.note: The Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET) is the mandatory statutory screening gateway established under the Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (Conduct of Examination) Rules for direct recruitment to all Group C non-gazetted ministerial, executive, and technical posts in Uttar Pradesh government departments. Recruits shortlisted through PET scorecards enter representative Group C cadres (such as Junior Assistant, Revenue Lekhpal, or Gram Panchayat Adhikari at Pay Level 3) and advance through departmental promotion committees.

exam_scheme.note: UPSSSC conducts PET as an offline OMR-based single-paper screening test consisting of 100 multiple-choice questions carrying 100 marks across 15 syllabus domains. Negative marking of 0.25 (1/4th of the marks assigned to that question) applies for every wrong answer. PET normalized scorecards are valid for 1 year from the date of result declaration.

financial_package.note: As a preliminary qualifying test, PET scorecards govern shortlisting for Group C subordinate posts spanning Pay Level 1 (Grade Pay ₹1,800, basic ₹18,000) up to Pay Level 6 (Grade Pay ₹4,200, basic ₹35,400). Financial figures below reflect the modal Group C entry appointment (Pay Level 3, Grade Pay ₹2,000) under the Uttar Pradesh Revised Pay Rules, 2016.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Uttar Pradesh Revised Pay Rules 2016 (7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 3)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 3 entry basic pay of ₹21,700 at 58% DA (effective 01.07.2025) plus UP house rent allowance (Class X cities such as Lucknow/Kanpur at ₹3,000–₹3,600 down to Class Z rural postings at ₹1,800) and city compensatory allowance, net of 10% NPS employee contribution (₹3,429) and group insurance scheme deductions.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) as notified semi-annually by UP Finance Department
House Rent Allowance (HRA) categorized by posting city tier (Class X, Y, Z)
City Compensatory Allowance (CCA) and rural posting allowances where applicable
Medical reimbursement under UP Government Servants Medical Attendance Rules
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% state government matching contribution
Leave travel concession (LTC), earned leave accumulation, and festival advances
